entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Garcia. The order number is 774-B-921.
Thank you, Maria. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes, delivered on December 22nd. Can you tell me what specifically the issue is?

They're just so painful. I've only used them a couple of times and they've given me terrible blisters on my heels. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I've never had a problem like this. I really needed this money back.

I understand, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I know this might be a basic question, but did you have a chance to adjust the position of the cleats? Sometimes that can affect the pressure points on the foot.
I tried, I moved them all around but it didn't help at all. The fit just feels wrong for my feet. I'm honestly just so sad about it.
I see. Well, let me just review the return eligibility for you. Please hold for one moment.
Thanks for your patience, Maria. I've double-checked our policy. Since your cycling shoes were delivered within the last 10 days, you are absolutely eligible for a full refund.
Oh, really? Thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

Not at all. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just package the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll process your full refund to the original payment method.
Thank you so much, Isaac. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Have a great day, and we hope to see you back at VeloFit soon. Goodbye.
